outcome: Resolution of serum beta human chorionic gonadotropin (b-hCG) levels
cohort: Four women referred to a hospital with a suspicion of Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) or cervical pregnancy, diagnosed at an average gestational age of 6.4 ± 0.9 weeks.
finding: Conservative medical management, including systemic or intragestational methotrexate, appears to be an effective first-choice therapy for Cesarean scar pregnancy, even with visible fetal cardiac activity or high initial b-hCG levels, though complete remission can take a relatively long time.
gest_age: Average gestational age of 6.4 ± 0.9 weeks at diagnosis.
